clue.text: Fine that is about lifted carpet design

explanation.definitionFit: A figure is a pattern or decorative motif, as in a figured fabric, so it can stand for a design.

clue.text: Books on operating system are finally superfluous

explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Albert Hall in Kensington, London, is one of Britain's best-known concert halls, home of the Proms.

clue.text: Flash preceding assault that makes satellite disappear
